subject: executor: prealloc memory for keys in HashJoinv2 (#63957)
summary: Reviewed the diff vs first parent focusing on HashJoinV2 key serialization/build/probe + spill-restore. The change preallocates per-row key buffers via a shared byte slice with per-row capacity capped using full-slice expressions, and keeps the serialization order/bytes produced by the existing encode logic. Size estimators added/used (`Collator.MaxKeyLen`, `MyDecimal.HashKeySize`, `BinaryJSON.CalculateHashValueSize`) are used only for preallocation; spill-restore preallocates by exact stored key lengths. No Blocker/High correctness, SQL semantics, concurrency, session/txn, or runtime-safety issues found. Later history up to `upstream/master` shows no follow-up changes in these touched paths.
